```{r score tanner boy}
# Tanner Scale (Male)  - Marshall & Tanner (1970)
# https://adc.bmj.com/content/45/239/13


# Load required packages
library(dplyr)
library (readr)

# Load data
tanner_boy <- read_tsv("/Users/bsevchik/projects/EF_clinical/self-report/scale_csvs_Jan/separate_tsvs/tanner_boy.tsv")

write_tsv(tanner_boy,"/Users/bsevchik/projects/EF_clinical/self-report/scale_csvs_Jan/final_scored_tsvs/tanner_boy.tsv", na = "n/a")
```
``` {r tanner boy distribution}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

tanner_boy %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = tanner_boy_total_score)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  labs(x = "Tanner (Male) total score (sum items 1–6)", y = "Number of sessions",
       title = "Distribution of Tanner (Male) total scores")

```
